The local 3-pack is where the money is

The three results in the map pack take the clicks, the calls and the directions; everything below the fold might as well not be there. On Google Maps and Apple Maps that pack reorders with every block the searcher is standing on, so “we’re in the 3-pack” is true on some streets and false on others — and one rank number can’t tell you which. Eagle Eye lays a grid of up to 441 points over a business and runs a real map search from every one, so you see exactly where it holds the top 3 and where it slips off the pack.

What a scan shows about the pack

  • Top 3 at every grid point — where the business makes the pack and where it doesn’t, street by street.
  • LSOV — the share of the grid where it ranks in the top 3, one number for how much of the area sees it in the pack.
  • A competitor map for every rival in the pack — who takes the top 3 on the blocks you lose, point by point.
  • An alert the moment a rival takes the top 3, as soon as a scan finds it — before the client does.

See the pack on a real business before you pay a cent: a new organisation gets 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own site is free at any size up to 21 × 21. See who’s winning the pack, then check what a scan costs — credits never expire.

Three numbers, every scan

The whole grid rolls up into the figures a client actually remembers — tracked every run so the trend is the proof.

LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

What is local pack tracking?

It measures where a business holds the local 3-pack — the three map results that take the clicks, calls and directions — across a whole area. The pack reorders block by block, so Eagle Eye checks it at every grid point, not from one spot.

How do I know what share of the area sees me in the 3-pack?

LSOV is exactly that: the share of the grid where you rank in the top 3, one number for how much of the area finds you in the pack.

Can I see which rival holds the pack where I lose it?

Eagle Eye draws a competitor map for every rival that outranks you — their rank at every point of the same grid — so you see exactly which competitor wins each block, not just that you place #5.

Will I be alerted if a rival takes the top 3?

Yes — set an alert and hear it the moment a rival takes the top 3, as soon as a scan finds it.

Can I try it on a real business free?

A new organisation starts with 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own website is free at any size up to 21 × 21 — no card needed.
